info.description: Customer-facing API of the Voice Agent Self-Service Portal (spec §16). Every non-public route takes `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`; workspace-scoped routes also take `X-Workspace-Id`. Errors are `{code, message, fields?}`. Long operations answer `202 {job_id}` and progress over `GET /events` (SSE) or `GET /jobs/:id`. Generated from backend/api/src/openapi/manifest.ts — do not edit by hand.
